content_sections.heading: About IIEST Shibpur Research Associate-I (RA-I)
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Engineering Science & Technology (IIEST), Shibpur is located in Howrah, West Bengal. This recruitment is issued by its Office of the Dean Research and Consultancy for the project "Scalable Manufacturing of Wrinkled Graphene FET Array with Fluidic Interface for Trace Exosome Detection Towards Early Cancer Diagnosis". The project runs under the PAIR Network titled "An Eight Institution Partnership for Advancing Materials Research and Development: From Fundamental Design to Emerging Applications in Structural, Functional and Biomaterials Spaces", with ANRF, Govt. of India as the sponsoring authority. The University Project Code is DRC/ANRF-PAIR (4211)/CHEM/PB/010/25-26.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: There is one post of Research Associate-I (RA-I) in the Department of Electronic and Telecommunication Engineering (ETCE), IIEST, Shibpur, Howrah-711 103. PhD in Biotechnology/Biomedical Engineering/Molecular Biology/Biophysics/Materials Science/Bioengineering/Nanotechnology/Chemical Engineering with specializations related to sensor devices, electrochemistry or equivalent/Electronics Engineering with Microelectronics or equivalent specialization or any allied fields from a recognized University/Institute. Hand-on experience in Electrochemical/Electronic biochemical sensor development Materials synthesis for biochemical sensors Molecular biology techniques for receptor developments The age limit is maximum 35 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age. The fellowship is Rs. 58,000/- + Rs. 17,400/- (HRA @30%) = Rs. 75,400/- per month. The HRA of 30% is included in the total of Rs. 75,400/-. Duration of the Project: Four years from the date of commencement or till the project continues whichever is earlier. Candidates should check the official notification for the full discipline-specific eligibility for the post.

rows.relaxation: Upper age limit relaxable upto 5 years

faq.question: Q1. When is the IIEST Shibpur Research Associate-I walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 1 December 2026 at 1:00 PM at the Office of the Dean (R&C), IIEST, Shibpur.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to e-mail the application?
faq.answer: Soft copies of the application must be e-mailed by November 30th, 2026 at 5:00 pm to [email protected].

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There is one (01) post of Research Associate-I (RA-I).

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for IIEST Shibpur RA-I?
faq.answer: A PhD in Biotechnology/Biomedical Engineering/Molecular Biology/Biophysics/Materials Science/Bioengineering/Nanotechnology/Chemical Engineering with specializations related to sensor devices, electrochemistry or equivalent/Electronics Engineering with Microelectronics or equivalent specialization or any allied fields from a recognized University/Institute.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is maximum 35 years, relaxable upto 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/Woman and Physically handicapped candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of IIEST Shibpur Research Associate-I?
faq.answer: The fellowship is Rs. 58,000/- + Rs. 17,400/- (HRA @30%) = Rs. 75,400/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the fellowship?
faq.answer: Yes, HRA at 30% (Rs. 17,400/-) is added to the Rs. 58,000/- fellowship, making Rs. 75,400/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents must be sent?
faq.answer: Self-attested soft copies of the application letter in plain paper, recent bio-data, mark sheets and certificates must be e-mailed in advance.

faq.question: Q9. How will the candidate be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through the walk-in interview, and short listing may be done before the interview.

faq.question: Q10. How long is the appointment?
faq.answer: The project duration is four years from the date of commencement or till the project continues, whichever is earlier.
